name: mkb-site
description: The page's scripts are ES modules; Node runs the shared ones (dwarf.js, kgen.js, wasi.js, kit.js, jumps.js...) and gen-dwarf.js, gen-src.js as modules too. build.mjs bundles the page (app.js, the modules it imports, the React components *.jsx and React) into app.bundle.js with esbuild. dependencies: React, bundled into the page; devDependencies: the bundler and the lint (eslint.config.mjs)
